rules.primary: Visitor open rate; intention-to-treat includes fallback. Manual modes excluded.
rules.minimum: 300 exposed visitors in each group; at least 7 days; one review per completed weekly window.
rules.promote: Relative gain >=10%, 95% difference lower bound >0, no guardrail breach; requires review, never auto-expands.
rules.pause: After 50 opens in each group, load errors or dismisses increase by >2 percentage points.
rules.incomplete: Insufficient sample is not success. Review again after the next complete weekly window.

interpretation: Only remembered visitors are measured. UTC returning visits are descriptive, not causal retention proof. Descriptions, opens and iframe loads do not prove learning or playability. Reserved cost includes unknown/failed calls; known actual cost is only reported usage, not the Cloudflare invoice.
